prompt.en: What is the minimum age to vote in Indian elections, and what is this right of all adult citizens called?
prompt.hi: Bharat mein vote dene ki nyuntam umar kya hai, aur sabhi vayask naagrikon ke is adhikaar ko kya kehte hain?

prompt.en: After a Lok Sabha election, Party A has 230 seats, Party B 200, and smaller parties the rest of the 543. Can Party A form the government alone? What could happen?
prompt.hi: Lok Sabha chunaav ke baad Party A ke 230 seat, Party B ke 200, aur baaki 543 mein se chhoti partiyon ke paas. Kya Party A akele sarkar bana sakti hai? Kya ho sakta hai?

challenges.hint: How many more does A need?

prompt.en: Using the same stall (price ₹30, cost ₹18 per sandwich, rent ₹200), how many sandwiches must be sold to cover all costs?
prompt.hi: Usi stall ke liye (daam ₹30, har sandwich ka kharcha ₹18, kiraya ₹200), saare kharche nikaalne ke liye kitne sandwich bechne honge?

challenges.hint: How many of those ₹12s cover the rent?
